mapper.sql: task.id, task.user_id, task.language_profile_id, task.material_id, task.published_version, profile.language_code AS target_language, task.support_language, task.difficulty, task.estimated_duration_minutes, task.scenario, task.primary_goal, task.task_type, task.planning_reason, task.status, task.created_at, task.started_at, task.completed_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO learning_task ( user_id, language_profile_id, material_id, published_version, support_language, difficulty, estimated_duration_minutes, scenario, primary_goal, task_type, planning_reason ) SELECT profile.user_id, profile.id, #{materialId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{publishedVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{supportLanguage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{difficulty, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{estimatedDurationMinutes, jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{scenario, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{primaryGoal, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taskType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planningReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM language_profile profile WHERE profile.id = #{languageProfileId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND profile.user_id = #{trustedUserId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND profile.language_code = #{targetLanguage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} RETURNING id
